The shortfall is dominated by the recorded coda-scaffold removal, the linked reading-path lines, and ledger-bounded sentences whose interiors changed by one modality word.

findings.summary: The chamber's coda scaffold is not restored.

evidence.baseline: The right people are out there, and the meeting is left to luck. ... That is why Providence exists at all.

findings.authorizedBy: The voice card's known weak passages, and the semantic review's record of the coda removal.
findings.diagnosis: Coda scaffold not restored. The baseline closes this chamber with a divider, two italic address lines, the isolated line That is why, and a fourth italic line beginning That is why. The Volume VI voice card lists any return of the repeated divider plus That is why coda among its known weak passages, and the semantic review records the pass's removal of the scaffold as a structural repair. The address lines also tell the reader what they have felt, waited for, or were made to become, which is the defect CTD-0091 was opened for and which the corpus card forbids outright. The scaffold is therefore left removed. Where a coda carried content rather than performance, that content is restored into the chamber body.

findings.diagnosis: The card records reverence as an offered register in this volume, and almost as an act of devotion is where the chamber offers it. The depth within one another is also the sentence that connects the loom back to the unspent gift three chambers earlier.

R-PAIRED-DELETION. Term sweep run over the section's distinctive named terms against the baseline and the current corpus. No cross-reference was restored at one end; no dependency blocks. The resource we most reliably overlook pairs with Volume V's renamed chapter; both ends follow the live heading, and the baseline pair was renamed at both ends by one decision, so nothing dangles.

R-DEIXIS and R-TENSE checked against the baseline's demonstratives and verb forms. Nothing fires. R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD. No claim named in an open canon query was cut from this section by this audit or left unrecorded by generation A.
Nothing further fires. The prose stands as generation A left it.
